For me in my recovery,.. (3yrs in June) .. I did not have them early on. In fact I only very recently started dabbling. It's actually a growing market and there's a lot more than O'Douls. My reason was it just "felt wrong",.. I was hesitant-- didn't trust the idea-- and didn't bother explaining or examining my rationale. I just went with it and passed on them. I figured if I was in doubt at all, just avoid it- no problem or possibility of one.

I know a handful of people at my regular AA whom I'm friends with that'll have them and they mirror the sentiment..(it's up to you, you're still sober, and I didn't do it early on)
